const {chromium}=require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH||'playwright'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
(async()=>{const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,executablePath:process.env.CHROME_PATH});const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1280,height:900}}),errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await page.goto('http://localhost:4173');await page.click('#play');await page.click('#choose-mystic');assert.equal(await page.getAttribute('#choose-mystic','aria-pressed'),'true');await page.locator('.screen').screenshot({path:__dirname+'/preview-three-characters.png'});await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});const fit=await page.evaluate(()=>{const a=document.querySelector('.screen').getBoundingClientRect(),b=document.querySelector('#character-picker').getBoundingClientRect();return b.top>=a.top&&b.bottom<=a.bottom+1&&document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth;});assert(fit);console.log('PASS five character cards fit mobile');await page.setViewportSize({width:1280,height:900});await page.click('#character-start');await page.waitForTimeout(400);await page.keyboard.press('KeyJ');await page.waitForTimeout(50);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>shots.length),0);console.log('PASS mystic starts without an attack');await page.evaluate(()=>{world.enemies=[];const it={type:'mysticOrb',x:0,y:0};items.push(it);power(it);});await page.keyboard.press('KeyJ');await page.waitForTimeout(50);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>shots[0].weapon),'wave');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>shots[0].vy),0);console.log('PASS horizontal wave via real J key');await page.evaluate(()=>{shots=[];player.fire=0;const it={type:'mysticOrb',x:0,y:0};items.push(it);power(it);});await page.keyboard.press('KeyJ');await page.waitForTimeout(50);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>shots[0].weapon),'arrow');await page.evaluate(()=>{const a=shots[0];a.x=100;a.y=160;a.vx=3.5;a.vy=0;a.age=10;a.returning=false;player.x=100;player.y=135;player.vx=0;player.vy=1;player.ground=false;player.inv=0;});await page.waitForTimeout(100);assert(await page.evaluate(()=>shots[0].anchored));assert(await page.evaluate(()=>player.ground));await page.locator('#game').screenshot({path:__dirname+'/preview-mystic-arrow.png'});await page.waitForTimeout(5200);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>shots.filter(b=>b.weapon==='arrow').length),0);assert(await page.evaluate(()=>player.y+player.h>160));console.log('PASS landing creates a five-second platform, then expires');assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);console.log('PASS no browser errors');await browser.close();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});
